releaseNotes: v1.0.49 - Dashboard tiles now display. The status and recent-files tiles were too long for Hubitat dashboards (1024 character limit), so each is now saved as a small file on the hub and shown through a short link. Just add an Attribute tile for aaStatusTile or filesListTile. Added a support link on the device page. v1.0.48 - Consecutive failure threshold before marking offline (default 3, configurable). Auto-reconnect after outage, driver self-heals without manual intervention. Status tile now correctly shows offline state with last known temps instead of stuck online badge.
author: jdthomas24
description: Hubitat driver for Moonraker/Klipper 3D printers. Monitor print status, temperatures, and progress via live dashboard tiles. Start, pause, resume, and cancel prints directly from Hubitat or any automation rule. Supports Sonicpad multi-printer setups and standard Raspberry Pi/BTT installs.

drivers.name: Moonraker Klipper Printer
drivers.description: One device per printer. Monitors print state, temperatures and progress with dashboard tiles, and starts, pauses, resumes or cancels prints.
